The On Running Cloud 6 Waterproof brings the brand's signature CloudTec cushioning to a fully weatherproofed trainer, built for anyone who needs reliable performance regardless of what the forecast throws at them. Finished in olive green with a darker olive overlay across the toe cap, lace facings and heel counter, this trainer has a layered, technical look that suits both training sessions and everyday wear. The ribbed mesh upper is reinforced with smoother synthetic panels for structure, while small reflective details on the heel and forefoot add a practical touch for low-light visibility.

Underfoot, the CloudTec sole is unmistakably On: individual hollow tread pods run across the forefoot and midfoot before merging into a solid heel block, with a two-tone gum and beige outsole and a raised central ridge underneath for grip and flex. Flat woven laces in a contrasting tan tone thread through a metal-rimmed eyelet and a circular drawcord loop at the tongue, while a fabric pull-tab at the heel makes it easy to get on and off. A red Swiss flag badge on the lateral heel nods to the brand's Swiss engineering heritage, and the printed WATERPROOF wordmark on the quarter panels confirms this is built for damp conditions without compromising on the lightweight feel On is known for.

Whether it's for road running in unpredictable weather or simply as a comfortable, durable trainer for daily use, the Cloud 6 Waterproof is a practical pick for anyone after a low-top shoe that handles rain as well as it handles miles. Its below-ankle fit and lace-up closure make it easy to size correctly, and the olive colourway offers a versatile, easy-to-wear alternative to the more common black or white options.
